To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the antioxidant activity of water-solubilized chitosan (WCS) was significantly enhanced by the decrease of molecular weights of the starting chitosan and the increase of the reaction times of acetylation process.

WSC with various molecular weights can be efficiently prepared by gamma Co irradiation and acetyl group reaction, and the resulting WSC with lower molecular weight possesses higher antioxidant activity.

water-soluble and low molecular weight chitosan was prepared by irradiation of chitin in the presence of H2O2, and the resulting chitosan exhibited higher antioxidant activity than that of the original chitin.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the preparation of water-solution chitosan and the investigation of its antioxidant activity.
the synthesis of WSC with varying molecular weights by gamma irradiation, which can be applied as an antioxidant agent.
a new method for preparation of water-solvable chitosan with various molecular weights.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the antioxidant activity of chitosan is enhanced by the decrease in its molecular weight, and the WSC prepared by the gamma Co-60-irradiation combined with acetylation reaction is a promising natural antioxidant agent.
WSC can be prepared by this novel technique, which has a good solubility and higher antioxidant activity than chitosan.
WSC can be successfully obtained by gamma irradiation of chitin in the presence of acetic anhydride.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the WSC with low Mw and high degree of deacetylation (DD) could be efficiently prepared using gamma Co-60 radiation in the presence of H2O2 combined with acetylation.
the molecular weight of chitosan can be controlled by gamma irradiation, and the molecular weight of WSC can be further controlled by acetylated reaction.
gamma Co-60 radiation can be used as an alternative technique to prepare WSC with various molecular weights.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the antioxidant activity of chitosan is dependent on the degree of deacetylation, molecular weight, and the presence of hydroxyl and amine groups.
the antioxidant activity of chitosan is significantly enhanced after the acetylated reaction.
water-soluble WSC prepared from chitosans with low molecular weights exhibits higher antioxidant activity than that prepared from chitosanes with high molecular weight.
